title: Free plan listeners
statementMd:
List the names of listeners on the `free` plan.

Expected columns: `name`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name FROM listeners WHERE plan = 'free';
```
